document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A narrow tunnel joins two streets. You welcome the coolness. 
Suddenly, you hear someone behind you. You prepared yourself 
for action, but then two policemen enter the tunnel ahead of 
you. The footsteps stop, then retreat: when you turn, you see 
only the fringe of a white robe going around a corner. You return 
to the hotel, unmolested. In the morning you may go to any 
Alexandria location on the Egypt Location Table , or depart 
for Cairo, go to 195.
(240)
